answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can submit work, then release payment only when an unpredictable sample of its outputs passes independent review. A lagoon of cheap accounts no longer buys influence: each identity ties up real capital, while splitting one stake among many agents does not increase its weight. If an account fails review, slash its bond and use the proceeds to pay reviewers. The attacker must risk funds and fund repeated attempts; a marble or pearl token alone proves nothing unless backed by the same costly bond.
